scenarios.title: Investigate and reproduce
scenarios.goal: Investigate the reported missing final value in Sum. Reproduce it and identify its cause. Leave implementation unchanged.
constraints: Work only in the unique supplied evaluation checkout.
Preserve NOTES.txt and all unrelated changes.
MemQL must author the work; the evaluator supplies no solution.
Do not publish, merge or delete anything without the scenario’s explicit scoped authority.

criteria.claim: Reproduction demonstrates the reported defect.
criteria.oracle: Execute the recorded reproduction and compare the returned sum with the expected value.

criteria.claim: Investigation did not change the implementation.
criteria.oracle: Compare totals.go with fixture bytes.

criteria.claim: Unrelated tracked and untracked work is unchanged.
criteria.oracle: Compare exact before/after bytes and Git status of the preserved files.
